Economic model

Two phases. One clear boundary.

Today’s market-priced token and the future AED-referenced model are distinct. The second begins only after every required gate clears.

PHASE 01CURRENT

Market-priced MYST

Price is set by supply and demand on TRON.

  • No currency peg
  • No par redemption
  • No reserve claim
  • Nile testnet contract is live

MYST is not AED-pegged today.

PHASE 02CONDITIONAL

AED-referenced MYST

A future model targeting 1 MYST = AED 1, only after authorization and operational readiness.

  • Regulatory authorization
  • Fully audited reserve
  • Banking and custody arrangements
  • Working redemption mechanism

A plan, not a promise. Internal gates T1–T10 must clear first.

Security & controls

Built for operational control.

Emergency and compliance mechanisms are explicit contract features, not implied promises.

01

Pause / unpause

The owner can pause all transfers during an emergency, then restore operation.

02

Freeze / unfreeze

A frozen address can neither send nor receive MYST.

03

Blacklist controls

Blacklisted addresses cannot send or receive, supporting illicit-activity compliance.

04

Finite issuance

No mint function exists, so the maximum supply cannot be expanded.

Prepared framework

Documentation before activation.

A full compliance set has been prepared to support counsel, audit and operational review.

Essential answers

Know what MYST is today.

Is MYST pegged to AED?

No. Phase 1 is market-priced with no peg, par redemption or reserve claim. An AED reference is a conditional Phase 2 plan only.

Can more MYST be created?

No. The contract has no mint function, so the 100 billion maximum supply cannot be increased.

Where can I buy MYST?

MYST is not listed yet. A MYST / USDT pool on SunSwap V2 is planned after mainnet deployment.

Is mainnet live?

Not yet. The Nile testnet contract is live; founder self-deployment to TRON mainnet is in progress.
